wallet.title: Rent Wallet
wallet.intro: Every rupee of rent, working for you — track your tax savings and deposit, and build a verifiable Rent Passport that gets you priority with future landlords.
wallet.emptyBody: Rent a home on PuneNest and every payment starts working for you — tracked tax savings, a deposit tracker, and a verifiable <1>Rent Passport</1> you can show future landlords.
wallet.prototypeNote: Prototype — the demo rental seeds sample data so you can try every feature.
wallet.demoLoaded: Demo rental loaded — every feature is now testable.
wallet.demoAlready: A demo rental is already loaded.
wallet.buildPassport: Pay rent on PuneNest to build your Rent Passport.
wallet.passportSub: Your verifiable on-time-rent record — download it to win priority with future landlords.
wallet.passportNote: Only PuneNest turns your rent into a portable credential — it stays with you, not the landlord.
wallet.hraNote: Pune is a non-metro (40% of basic). Claim it in your ITR — your HRA receipts are ready under Rent payments.
wallet.addSalaryPrompt: Add your annual basic salary to see how much tax your rent is saving you.
wallet.depositSub: Your biggest locked-up amount — tracked to refund.
